Overview

Brest is a city in Brittany with a population of 140,000. A major Atlantic port city in Brittany with a dramatic coastline, a world-class oceanography institute, and a strong maritime culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
